Select compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism for CHEMBL1173655 and all salts with IC50 in nM against CHEMBL203. Define compound set via molecule_hierarchy from parent CHEMBL1173655. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records to docs to activities to assays to target_dictionary. Join compound_structures for canonical_smiles. Filter activities.standard_type = 'IC50' and activities.standard_units = 'nM' and target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203'. Keep all activity rows without deduplication. Do not limit rows.
